finding: No complete S5 endpoint was found in the explicitly inspected upstream sources. This is a bounded search conclusion, not a claim that no formal proof exists elsewhere.

first_missing_constructive_endpoint.domain: Every field k, an integral affine smooth finite-type X/k, a nonempty open A of X, an original A1-invariant presheaf with transfers P, v in P(X) restricting to zero on A, and a finite nonempty set sigma of arbitrary prime points of X.
first_missing_constructive_endpoint.required_conclusion: Construct one affine open O containing every point of sigma such that the literal graph restriction of v to O is zero.
first_missing_constructive_endpoint.available_conclusion: IntegralAffineLocalZero and integralAffineLocalZero_of_field construct a separate zero neighborhood for each single point x.
first_missing_constructive_endpoint.quantifier_difference: forall x exists O_x does not imply exists O forall x in sigma, without a descent/separation argument for the original P. Taking a union would require precisely the missing presheaf uniqueness statement.
other_supplier_limits: Finite correspondence support shrinking preserves full finite fibers only after the required opens have been supplied; it does not construct a transfer homotopy or a zero restriction.
PersistentSectionVanishing assumes an actual Nisnevich sheaf, so it cannot establish the original pre-separated PST injection.
exists_baseOnly_relativeCurve_lifting needs a supplied global diagonal frame and gives a base neighborhood of one selected point; it is not arbitrary finite-point standard-triple existence.
exists_nisnevichImage_representing_cover supplies a Nisnevich-cover representative, not simultaneous Zariski finite-point descent.
Nisnevich image and its HI property do not alone identify the Zariski separated quotient and the actual original finite-neighborhood unit.

supporting_implementation.purpose: Finite insertion induction using actual neighborhood values, stalks and overlap colimits; literal sheafification-unit assembly and compatibility with a separated-quotient reduction.
explicit_remaining_hypotheses: Pointwise injectivity for the separated presheaf's actual sheafification unit.
SingletonBlockGluing for the selected presheaf: compatible singleton and finite-block sections must genuinely glue on a simultaneous union neighborhood.
The actual map from the original PST to its separated quotient induces an isomorphism on the chosen finite-neighborhood colimit.
The actual sheafification map of that quotient map is an isomorphism.
supporting_implementation.scope: Conditional small-site assembly only. None of the missing transfer geometry is introduced as an axiom, proved by this helper, or claimed as complete S5 coverage.
